_comment: Injury type definitions used by engine/injuries.js (picking a random injury when a player goes down) and the Hospital tab (ui/hospitalUI.js). Optional — the app ships with an embedded fallback copy of this list in js/state.js, so editing this file works without a rebuild, same as leagues.json/managers.json/trophies.json.

injuries.name: Cut / Laceration
injuries.description: A deep cut or laceration, often to the head or face, requiring stitches or bandaging.
causes: suffered a deep cut to the head following a clash of heads
needed stitches after taking a stray elbow to the brow
was bandaged up and withdrawn following a sharp collision

injuries.name: Viral Illness
injuries.description: A sudden bout of flu, fever, or stomach bug rendering the player unfit to compete.
causes: was ruled out of the matchday squad due to a sudden fever
was sent home from training with a severe stomach bug
was left out of the team after falling ill overnight

injuries.name: Fractured Hand/Finger
injuries.description: A break or dislocation in the hand or finger bones, common when breaking falls or making saves.
causes: dislocated his finger while diving to make a save
fractured his hand after taking the full force of a point-blank shot
landed heavily on an outstretched hand and damaged his finger

injuries.name: Turf Toe
injuries.description: A sprain of the main joint of the big toe from hyperextension, common on hard surfaces.
causes: hyperextended his big toe while pushing off to sprint
was left hobbling after his toe bent back awkwardly on the turf
needed treatment after jamming his big toe into the ground

injuries.name: Heat Exhaustion / Dehydration
injuries.description: Severe fatigue, dizziness, or weakness brought on by fluid loss in hot match conditions.
causes: collapsed to his knees from exhaustion late in the second half
was taken off feeling dizzy and dehydrated on a sweltering afternoon
signalled to the bench after suffering severe fatigue

injuries.name: Eye Contusion
injuries.description: Swelling or vision obstruction caused by a direct blow around the eye orbit.
causes: took a stray finger to the eye during a corner kick battle
was withdrawn with a swelling eye after a collision
struggled with impaired vision after taking a ball to the face

injuries.name: Fractured Metacarpal
injuries.description: A break in one of the hand bones, often requiring a protective cast or splint.
causes: fractured a bone in his hand while breaking a heavy fall
was caught on the hand by a heavy boot going for a loose ball
suffered a hand fracture after a hard collision with the hoardings

injuries.name: Rotator Cuff Strain
injuries.description: A strain of the shoulder stability muscles, frequent in goalkeepers and long-throw specialists.
causes: felt a sharp pain in his shoulder after making a diving save
strained his shoulder muscle executing a long throw-in
was substituted holding his shoulder after over-extending

injuries.name: Quadriceps Tendonitis
injuries.description: Inflammation of the tendon connecting the quad muscle to the kneecap.
causes: felt a twinge above his kneecap after unleashing a powerful volley
was taken off after persistent front knee soreness limited his kicking
pulled up holding his upper knee following a goal-kick attempt

injuries.name: Herniated Disc
injuries.description: A spinal disc issue causing nerve compression and severe lower back/leg pain.
causes: went down in severe discomfort holding his lower back after a jump
was forced off as shooting back pain flared up during a sprint
suffered a severe back spasm and nerve compression after landing

injuries.name: Mandibular Fracture
injuries.description: A fracture of the jawbone, usually resulting from high-impact clashes.
causes: took a devastating boot to the jaw in a low-heading challenge
suffered a heavy clash of heads and went off with a jaw injury
was hit by a stray elbow and needed immediate medical attention for his jaw

injuries.name: IT Band Friction Syndrome
injuries.description: An overuse injury causing sharp pain on the outside of the knee joint due to repetitive running.
causes: was forced off after persistent lateral knee pain flared up
pulled up during a long run holding the outer side of his knee
was substituted as an overuse knee strain limited his mobility

injuries.name: Osteitis Pubis
injuries.description: A non-infectious inflammation of the pubic symphysis causing severe, chronic groin and pelvic pain.
causes: was withdrawn after chronic pelvic inflammation severely limited his movement
hobbled off as a persistent pubic bone strain flared up on a clearance
was replaced after struggling with severe, recurring lower abdominal tightness

injuries.name: Muscle Cramp
injuries.description: Sudden involuntary muscle contraction, usually brought on by fatigue or dehydration late in a match.
causes: felt a muscle seize up and had to be withdrawn as a precaution
was struck down by cramp late in the match
signalled to the bench after his leg locked up

injuries.name: Ankle Sprain
injuries.description: A stretching or partial tearing of the ligaments around the ankle joint.
causes: rolled his ankle after a heavy tackle
twisted his ankle awkwardly on the turf
went over on his ankle challenging for the ball
landed badly after an aerial duel and turned his ankle

injuries.name: Knee Knock
injuries.description: A bruising blow to the knee from a direct collision, with no ligament damage.
causes: took a knock on the knee in a goalmouth scramble
was caught by a stray boot on the knee
clattered knees with an opponent going for a header

injuries.name: Dead Leg (Contusion)
injuries.description: A deep muscle bruise caused by a direct blow to the thigh, temporarily numbing the leg.
causes: took a stray knee to the thigh and needed treatment
was caught by a heavy challenge on the thigh
picked up a dead leg after a collision

injuries.name: Concussion Protocol
injuries.description: Withdrawn as a head-injury precaution to be assessed under concussion protocol.
causes: clashed heads with an opponent and was taken off for a head-injury assessment
took a blow to the head in an aerial challenge
was withdrawn as a precaution after a heavy fall

injuries.name: Hamstring Strain
injuries.description: A partial tear of the hamstring muscle fibres, typically from an explosive sprint.
causes: pulled up sharply while chasing a through ball
felt his hamstring go mid-sprint
pulled up holding the back of his leg after a burst of pace
stretched to reach a pass and felt his hamstring tighten

injuries.name: Calf Strain
injuries.description: A tear in the calf muscle fibres, often from a sudden push-off or change of direction.
causes: pulled up with a tight calf after pushing off to sprint
felt his calf tighten and signalled to the bench
was substituted after feeling a twinge in his calf

injuries.name: Groin Strain
injuries.description: A tear in the groin muscles, commonly caused by a sudden stretch or change of direction.
causes: felt his groin go while stretching for the ball
pulled up sharply after a lunging challenge
was withdrawn after a sharp pain in his groin

injuries.name: Thigh Strain
injuries.description: A muscle tear in the front or back of the thigh from a sudden burst of effort.
causes: pulled up with a tight thigh chasing back
felt his quad tighten after a shot
was caught mid-stride by a muscle strain in his thigh

injuries.name: Back Spasm
injuries.description: An involuntary muscle spasm in the lower back, often from an awkward twist or landing.
causes: landed awkwardly and felt his back seize up
was withdrawn after his back locked up mid-match
twisted awkwardly clearing the ball and felt his back go

injuries.name: Shoulder Injury
injuries.description: Bruising or a mild joint sprain in the shoulder from a heavy fall or collision.
causes: landed heavily on his shoulder after a challenge
took a shoulder charge and needed treatment
fell awkwardly onto his shoulder in a goalmouth clash

injuries.name: Fractured Metatarsal
injuries.description: A break in one of the long bones of the foot, usually from a stray boot or a blocked shot.
causes: was caught late on the foot and immediately went down in pain
took a heavy stamp on the foot in a goalmouth scramble
twisted awkwardly and felt his foot give way

injuries.name: Knee Ligament Sprain (MCL)
injuries.description: A sprain of the medial collateral ligament from a sideways impact on a planted leg.
causes: was caught side-on by a heavy challenge on a planted leg
twisted awkwardly with his studs stuck in the turf
buckled at the knee after a sliding tackle from the side

injuries.name: Rib Fracture
injuries.description: A crack or break in a rib bone, usually from a direct collision or heavy fall.
causes: took an elbow to the ribs in an aerial duel
landed hard on an opponent's knee after a challenge
collided heavily with the goalkeeper going for the ball

injuries.name: Facial Fracture
injuries.description: A break to the bones of the face, typically from an accidental clash of heads or a stray elbow.
causes: clashed heads with an opponent going for the same ball
took an accidental elbow to the face
was caught flush in the face by a clearance

injuries.name: Hip Flexor Tear
injuries.description: A tear in the muscles connecting the thigh to the hip, from an explosive kicking or sprinting motion.
causes: felt his hip go through on an over-stretched clearance
pulled up sharply mid-sprint holding his hip
over-extended for a tackle and felt his hip flexor tear

injuries.name: ACL Tear
injuries.description: A tear of the anterior cruciate ligament — one of football's most serious injuries, usually needing surgery and months of rehab.
causes: planted awkwardly and his knee buckled with no one near him
landed from a jump with his knee twisting inward and went down clutching it
was caught with his studs stuck in the turf as his knee gave way

injuries.name: Achilles Tendon Rupture
injuries.description: A complete tear of the Achilles tendon, one of the longest lay-off injuries in the game.
causes: pushed off to sprint and went down instantly clutching his ankle
felt something snap in his heel with no contact from anyone
collapsed to the turf mid-stride grabbing the back of his ankle

injuries.name: Fractured Tibia/Fibula
injuries.description: A break to one or both of the lower leg bones, almost always from a serious, high-impact challenge.
causes: was caught by a reckless, high challenge on the lower leg
took the full force of a mistimed tackle on his shin
was on the end of a heavy, studs-up challenge

injuries.name: Shin Splints
injuries.description: Pain along the shin bone caused by repetitive stress on hard pitch surfaces.
causes: was struggling with shin pain throughout the second half
signalled to the bench after feeling persistent soreness in his shins
was taken off to avoid aggravating a shin reaction

injuries.name: Wrist Sprain
injuries.description: A stretch or tear of wrist ligaments, often from breaking a heavy fall.
causes: landed heavily on his outstretched hand after an aerial duel
went down awkwardly and clutched his wrist in pain
was replaced after twisting his wrist during a tumble

injuries.name: Hip Pointer (Contusion)
injuries.description: A painful bruise on the iliac crest of the pelvis following a direct impact.
causes: took a hard blow to the hip in a sliding challenge
landed heavily on his side on the hard turf
collided with the advertising hoardings and bruised his hip

injuries.name: Plantar Fasciitis
injuries.description: Inflammation of the tissue on the bottom of the foot, causing sharp heel pain.
causes: was visibly hobbling due to foot discomfort late in the game
pulled up with severe pain in the arch of his foot
was withdrawn after struggling with persistent heel pain

injuries.name: Fractured Toe
injuries.description: A hairline or full break in a toe bone, typically from getting stepped on.
causes: was stamped on late during a tight duel
took a direct hit to the foot while blocking a shot
kicked the bottom of an opponent's boot going for a 50-50 ball

injuries.name: Abdominal Strain
injuries.description: A strain in the abdominal core muscles from twisting or stretching to make contact.
causes: felt a sharp pain in his midsection while twisting to head the ball
pulled an abdominal muscle while stretching for a volley
was forced off holding his stomach after a acrobatic clearance

injuries.name: Sports Hernia
injuries.description: A strain or tear of soft tissue in the lower abdomen or groin area.
causes: felt severe tightness in his lower abdominal wall when changing direction
was substituted after persistent groin stiffness flared up again
pulled up sharp while making a sweeping cross into the box

injuries.name: Adductor Tendonitis
injuries.description: Inflammation of the adductor tendons inside the thigh due to repetitive kicking.
causes: felt recurring groin soreness while taking a goal kick
was taken off after feeling a twinge inside his upper thigh
hobbled off after an intense sequence of lateral movements

injuries.name: Shoulder Dislocation
injuries.description: The upper arm bone pops out of the shoulder socket after a collision or fall.
causes: dislocated his shoulder in a heavy collision with the goalkeeper
fell awkwardly with his arm extended and went down holding his shoulder
was yanked back awkwardly in a shirt-pulling incident

injuries.name: Fractured Clavicle
injuries.description: A break in the collarbone, usually caused by landing directly on the point of the shoulder.
causes: landed heavily on his shoulder after being upended in the air
took a direct blow to the collarbone in a aerial collision
was driven into the turf following a mistimed challenge

injuries.name: Hyperextended Knee
injuries.description: Occurs when the knee is bent backward beyond its normal range of motion.
causes: had his leg driven backward in a heavy 50-50 challenge
landed awkwardly with a locked leg on a firm pitch
suffered a hyperextension after kicking through an opponent's block

injuries.name: Meniscus Tear
injuries.description: A tear in the shock-absorbing cartilage of the knee joint, often requiring arthroscopic surgery.
causes: twisted his knee sharply while turning with the ball
felt his knee catch and lock up during a rapid pivot
went down clutching his knee after studs caught in the turf

injuries.name: PCL Sprain
injuries.description: Damage to the posterior cruciate ligament, usually caused by a direct impact to the front of the knee.
causes: took a direct blow to the front of his shin while tackling
fell hard directly onto a bent knee
collided heavily knee-first into the post

injuries.name: High Ankle Sprain
injuries.description: A sprain of the high ankle ligaments above the ankle joint, taking significantly longer to heal than standard sprains.
causes: had his foot twisted outward in a heavy sliding tackle
was trapped under another player's weight in a goalmouth scramble
suffered a severe high ankle twist when his studs caught on the turn

injuries.name: Fractured Zygomatic Bone
injuries.description: A break in the cheekbone, usually caused by a clash of heads or high elbow.
causes: took a severe elbow to the cheek in an aerial challenge
clashed faces violently with a defender going for a header
was struck directly in the face by a clearing kick

injuries.name: Fractured Scaphoid
injuries.description: A break to one of the small carpal bones in the wrist, often requiring immobilization.
causes: fell backward and braced his fall with a firm wrist
was hit at point-blank range on the wrist by a powerful shot
collided violently with the goalpost attempting to keep a ball in play

injuries.name: Isolated Fibula Fracture
injuries.description: A break to the smaller, non-weight-bearing outer bone of the lower leg.
causes: was caught by a late, sweeping challenge on the side of his leg
took a direct kick to the outer calf during a tackle
twisted his ankle so violently that the outer bone fractured

injuries.name: Severe Hamstring Avulsion
injuries.description: A complete tear of the hamstring muscle away from the bone, requiring surgical reattachment.
causes: pulled up screaming in agony mid-sprint and collapsed
stretched excessively for a loose ball and felt a severe tear
suffered a total muscle tear sprinting on a cold night

injuries.name: Patellar Tendon Rupture
injuries.description: A tear of the tendon attaching the kneecap to the shinbone, making it impossible to straighten the leg.
causes: landed heavily from a leap and his knee buckled completely
felt his kneecap give way while trying to jump for a header
pushed off aggressively to sprint and went down clutching his knee cap

injuries.name: Hip Labral Tear
injuries.description: A tear in the cartilage ring lining the hip joint socket, necessitating extended surgical rehab.
causes: suffered a sharp twisting injury in his hip joint during a rapid turn
over-pivoted aggressively under pressure from a defender
felt a deep pop in his hip socket while striking a ball on the stretch

injuries.name: Pelvic Fracture
injuries.description: A severe structural break to the pelvic structure following an intense high-impact collision.
causes: was crushed in a terrifying high-speed collision with the goalkeeper
landed violently from a high jump onto his side after being flipped in the air
was caught in a catastrophic multi-player collision in the box
